title: Toll the Dead
contents: text | Target makes a WIS save or takes 1d8 necrotic (or 1d12 if it is missing any HP); success: no damage.
bullet | Choose one creature you can see within range.
footer | Spell | Cantrip | Pact of the Tome

title: Chill Touch
contents: text | On hit: 1d8 necrotic, and the target can’t regain HP until your next turn; undead has disadvantage on attacks against you until then.
footer | Spell | Cantrip | Pact of the Tome

title: Mage Hand
contents: text | Create a spectral hand that can manipulate objects, open/close, stow/retrieve items, or pour contents.
bullet | Move the hand up to 30 ft per action.
bullet | Can’t attack, use magic items, or carry > 10 lb.
bullet | Cast: 1 action. Control: your action.
footer | Spell | Cantrip | Pact of the Tome

title: Minor Illusion
contents: text | Create a sound or a static image (5-ft cube). Interacting with it reveals the illusion.
bullet | One illusion at a time; image has no motion, light, or smell.
bullet | Inspect (action): INT (Investigation) vs your save DC reveals it.

title: Guidance
contents: text | Add +1d4 to one ability check of a willing creature you touch (once; then ends).
bullet | Target: willing creature you touch.
bullet | Use: before the check, roll d4 and add it.
bullet | Not for attack rolls or saving throws.
bullet | Concentration: ends on new concentration or failed CON save vs damage.
footer | Spell | Cantrip | Pact of the Tome

title: Sacred Flame
contents: text | Target makes a DEX save or takes 1d8 radiant; no cover bonus; success: no damage.
bullet | Radiant flare on a creature you can see.
bullet | Cast: 1 action. Defense: DEX save (no cover).

title: Disguise Self
contents: text | Change your visual appearance (incl. gear); appear ±1 ft in height; can’t alter basic body shape.
bullet | Visual only; physical interaction reveals it.
bullet | Doesn’t change size category or item function.
bullet | Inspect (action): INT (Investigation) vs your save DC.

title: Misty Step
contents: text | Teleport 30 ft to an unoccupied space you can see.
bullet | Teleportation doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.
bullet | Sight required; no path needed.

title: Silvery Barbs
contents: text | When a creature you see succeeds on an attack, check, or save, it rerolls and must use the new roll; then choose a different creature you see to gain advantage on its next attack/check/save within 1 minute.
bullet | Advantage is used once or expires after 1 minute.
bullet | Trigger: a creature you see within 60 ft succeeds on an attack/check/save.

title: Invisibility
contents: text | Touched creature becomes invisible until the spell ends; ends early if it attacks or casts a spell.
bullet | Worn and carried items are also invisible.
bullet | Taking damage doesn’t end the effect.
bullet | Higher levels: affect +1 creature per slot above 2nd.

title: Find Familiar
contents: text | ComponentsV, S, M (incense & herbs worth 10 gp, consumed)
text | Summon a spirit familiar (celestial, fey, or fiend) that takes an animal form. It acts independently but obeys you; it can’t attack.
bullet | Telepathy within 100 ft; as an action, see/hear through it until your next turn (you are blind/deaf to your own senses).
bullet | Cast a touch spell through the familiar if it’s within 100 ft (your attack/save DC).
bullet | Action: dismiss into a pocket space; action: resummon. Recast to change its form.
bullet | In combat it rolls its own initiative and takes its own turns; no Attack action.
footer | Spell | 1st level | Book of Ancient Secrets

title: Detect Magic
contents: text | Sense the presence of magic within 30 ft for the duration.
bullet | If magic is present, you can use your action to see faint auras around visible creatures/objects and learn each school of magic.
bullet | Moves with you; reveals ongoing spells and magical items through their auras.
bullet | As a ritual, casting time is 10 minutes longer (no slot).
